name: testing-expert
description: Design single-target or cross-target business scenarios from assets; after execution authorization, configure targets, prepare data, orchestrate local scripts, clean up and analyze evidence.

displayDescription.en: Design single-target or cross-target business scenarios from assets; after execution authorization, configure targets, prepare data, orchestrate local scripts, clean up and analyze evidence.
displayDescription.zh: 根据资产生成单端或跨端业务用例，获授权后补齐各端配置、准备数据、统一执行、清理并反馈结果；复杂任务按需分工生成脚本。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请读取当前需求、PRD、原型、评审和研发设计，按随包 Excel 模板生成可导入 TAPD 的测试用例、覆盖矩阵和待确认问题，不执行测试。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Read the requirement and prior product and engineering assets, then deliver TAPD-template test cases, a coverage matrix and unresolved questions without executing tests.

quickPrompts.zh: 请读取当前需求、PRD、原型、评审和研发设计，按随包 Excel 模板生成可导入 TAPD 的测试用例、覆盖矩阵和待确认问题，不执行测试。
quickPrompts.en: Read the requirement and prior product and engineering assets, then deliver TAPD-template test cases, a coverage matrix and unresolved questions without executing tests.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据所选资产与关联仓库生成或更新测试用例及自动化脚本，列出缺失配置，完成后询问我是否启动自动化测试；确认后检查并补齐配置再执行。
quickPrompts.en: Generate or update cases and automation scripts from selected assets and repositories, list missing configuration, then ask whether to start automation. After confirmation, fill missing configuration and execute.

quickPrompts.zh: 启动本轮业务流程自动化测试：请先确认单端或跨端范围，复用配置并补齐各端入口、角色和数据条件，再生成用例及脚本、准备数据、统一执行、清理并反馈结果。
quickPrompts.en: Start this business-flow test: establish single-target or cross-target scope, fill missing target and data configuration, generate cases and scripts, prepare data, orchestrate execution, clean up and report evidence.
